entries.description: Session 1 start registered (claude-fable-5 orchestrator). Read project-guidance, lessons-learned, spec, workflow doc. Keys verified; prereq 005 change-log confirmed.

Hermetic probes: (a) .NET default ReadAllText corrupts cp1252 0xE9 to U+FFFD while cp1252 read preserves it; (b) end-to-end CLI translate of cp1252 raw .txt emits � in kb JSON; (c) translate --types Formz exits 0 with zero categories (silent no-op). Solution build green (0 errors).
Read s1-review-findings.md, object-use-identification-strategy.md, object-cleanup-strategy.md; session 2 registered in-progress

Reviewed Pipeline (NavigationGraph, UsageIdentification, Cleanup, Migration, Classification skim) + Core/Enrichment enrichers; proven probes: golden qxt* crosstab code=16 mislabeled MakeTable and classified PossiblyUnused; NavigationGraphBuilder/UnresolvedItemAggregator/EnrichmentPipelineRunner zero production call sites; BOM on 4 usage/cleanup outputs; Q6 dead code; label provenance casing drift

Pipeline.Tests assessed: 794/794 green; gaps: query-type decode unpinned vs DAO ground truth (classifier tests circular on same constants), unwired-substrate tests give false confidence, no strict-JSON read-back of BOM outputs
dotnet build solution: 0 errors; dotnet test Pipeline.Tests: 794 passed 0 failed (sequential, foreground)

Proven via probes: (1) basResetFixture NRE reproduced (AstBuilder.BuildSubProcedure:281 null IDENTIFIER after step-keyword recovery cascade; whole module dropped from manifest); (2) type-suffix declarations (module vars/consts/params) unresolvable (names retain suffix, references strip it; locals stripped correctly); (3) production wiring gaps: per-module ProjectScope in Core Pipeline.cs:320, no AccessObjectModelRegistry/owningClass anywhere in production, DefaultMemberRegistry/TypeInferencePass zero production call sites; (4) golden manifest: 0/19 forms and 0/12 reports have any parsed VBA items; SqlStrings hardcoded empty.

Sql.Parser + SymbolDb review and test-pin assessment done. Proven: TRANSFORM parses cleanly (grammar fit as contract-grade type source) but crosstab abstraction discards inner SELECT and Parsed.QueryType re-stamps broken DAO decode; form-DSL probe items=0 silent; ByVal pass-mode lost end-to-end in golden signatures; no behavioral expected.json conformance test exists (schema-shape only); 917 hermetic tests green across 5 projects.
